Is there work for dc now? dc can take, off menuz's files: (a) done.md's 2.14.1 entry drafted now from the CHANGELOG and the three approved designs, completed as the landings come in (S); (b) a second read of 0079's shell diff for bash 3.2 and GNU-against-BSD idioms beside the shellcheck pass, as your 18 Oct read did (XS); (c) the Linux leg for 0079's candidate on kovacs before it lands, since relink.bats runs on Ubuntu and went red there on 17 Oct (AT17's stat -f), only if hv starts kovacs (S); or anything else you name.
